usageNotes: Use this endpoint to register one or more PVE or PBS subscription keys with the PDM subscription pool; PMG/POM keys are not yet supported. The call is all-or-nothing: if any key has an unrecognized prefix or already exists in the pool, the entire request fails and the pool is left untouched. Pass the digest returned by a prior read to guard against concurrent modifications, or chain follow-up mutations directly using the digest included in the response without a separate refetch.

examples.summary: Add two PBS subscription keys to the pool

tips: Duplicate keys within a single request are silently collapsed — check the 'deduplicated' field in the response to distinguish accidental double-paste from an actual add.
A key that already exists in the pool causes a hard CONFLICT error for the whole request; remove existing keys first with the corresponding DELETE endpoint if you need to re-add.
Keys must match the PRODUCT_KEY_REGEX pattern (PVE or PBS prefix); validate prefixes client-side before submitting to avoid an all-or-nothing failure on a large batch.
The response includes a fresh digest, allowing you to chain a follow-up write (e.g., delete or update) without an extra GET round-trip.
